Alex / Priyanka —

Thanks for looping us in. A few technical notes to frame the capacity ask:

1) Model footprint & batch behavior
- With the model variant Aurora mentioned (v2-13B quantized), single-token latency on A10G is ~10–13ms under steady state; batch sizes and sequence lengths raise tokens/sec linearly but increase tail.

2) Warm-start pool sizing
- Recommendation: explicit warm-start pool equal to ~4% of peak replicas when you have spiky bursts (as you described). That pool should persist warm KV caches for common prefixes. For +40 GPUs we estimate 6–8 warm nodes depending on model memory.

3) Min/Max & scale-up lag
- Min replicas: size to cover 35–45% of your current average qps to avoid cold-starts during steady traffic.
- Max replicas: set to 110–120% of expected peak with headroom for autosurge.
- Scale-up lag: param we can tune — we recommend initial aggressive ramp of 20–30s to bring warm nodes online, then 2–3x smoothing to avoid overshoot.

4) Observability hooks
- We'll expose per-route token/sec and p95 latency metrics and provide a webhook for autoscale events so Aurora can correlate deployments with the feature rollout.

I'll attach an example throughput tuning sheet. Happy to walk through these on the call.

Karthik
